outcome.name: Children under 5 years who are stunted (height-for-age) (%) (ind_068)

source.from: NITI team's prescriptive district view for under-5 stunting (Tableau Public, karnataka.data.lake)
source.dataset: NFHS-6 district indicators; pre-school attendance from Poshan Tracker FY 2024-25

method.model: One linear model fitted across Karnataka's districts: stunting % = intercept + the sum of each factor's coefficient x its value. Each factor also has its own correlation (Pearson r) with stunting.
method.target: Cut the district's stunting by 20% (the workbook's default).
method.allocation: Equal allocation: each of the buckets takes an equal share of the cut, split equally among its factors.
method.prescribed: A factor's prescribed value is how far it would have to move, along the model, to deliver its share of the cut (kept within 0-100%). Change is that move as a % of today's value; factors are listed by change, largest first, as in the dashboard.
method.caveat: The model is a correlation across districts, not proof that changing a factor would change stunting. The authors mark it PROVISIONAL.

factors.name: Children age 3–6 recorded as school-going
factors.measures: Share of children aged 3-6 recorded as attending pre-school in Poshan Tracker data, FY 2024-25.

factors.name: Children age 6–23 months receiving an adequate diet
factors.measures: Share of children aged 6-23 months who received a minimum acceptable diet (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Children given the hepatitis B birth-dose vaccine
factors.measures: Share of children aged 12-23 months who received the hepatitis B vaccine dose given at birth (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Households using iodized salt
factors.measures: Share of households using iodised salt (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Births delivered in a health facility
factors.measures: Share of births in the last five years that took place in a hospital, health centre or other health facility (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Mothers who took iron-folic acid for 180+ days in pregnancy
factors.measures: Share of mothers who took iron-folic acid tablets for at least 180 days during their last pregnancy (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Women with low BMI, below 18.5
factors.measures: Share of women aged 15-49 whose body mass index is below 18.5, i.e. underweight (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Household members covered by health insurance
factors.measures: Share of households with any usual member covered under a health insurance or financing scheme (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Women married before age 18, age 20–24
factors.measures: Share of women aged 20-24 who were married before age 18 (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Women using a bank or savings account
factors.measures: Share of women aged 15-49 who have a bank or savings account they themselves use (NFHS-6).

factors.name: Women using a mobile phone
factors.measures: Share of women aged 15-49 who have a mobile phone they themselves use (NFHS-6).
